nina: Promo blocked — postsubmit artifact push failing with 504s to object store, deploy-bot paused promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact upload failed (504) attempts=5/5 state=hold

max: Which artifact? Any way to retry to another region?

nina: backend v2026.5.0 bundle `backend-2026.5.0.tar.gz` from us-east runner. Multipart finalize times out.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing elevated 504s for us-east storage frontends, paging storage team (#infra-9001).

max: Recommend manual promote to last-known-good `sha:1122aa` to keep the change window open, then reattempt upload next window.

nina: Agreed. /deploybot promote --sha 1122aa --env prod --reason "artifact upload 504, manual pin"

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by @nina. Promotion completed: sha 1122aa promoted to prod at 2026-05-04T16:12:00Z.

sre-oncall: Storage team acknowledged and started a rolling fix; ETA ~30m. Logging incident and scheduling postmortem.

max: I'll own retry plan for upload (lower concurrency + smaller chunks) and update release notes.
